author: nickyeow

english.text: My father teaches English at a high school.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 hai2 zung1 hok6 dou6 gaau3 jing1 man2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It took me five minutes to solve the problem.

jyutping: ngo5 jung6 jat1 go3 zi6 zau6 gai3 hou2 zo2 tiu4 sou3。

english.text: I don't understand what you are talking about.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4 nei5 hai2 dou6 ngap1 mat1。

english.text: He often walks with his hand in his pocket.

jyutping: hai6 mai6 so2 jau5 zoek3 zai2 dou1 sik1 fei1 gaa3？

english.text: It's fun to knead dough.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 aan3 zo2 hei2 san1，so2 ji5 ngo5 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung6 mei6 sik6 zou2 caan1。

jyutping: tong1 mou5 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3 paau2 saam1 ci3 bou6。

english.text: Could you place your bags on the scale, please?

english.text: The police were unable to get anything out of the woman.

jyutping: ging2 caat3 hai2 go3 neoi5 jan2 dou6 man6 m4 dou3 jam6 ho4 je5。

english.text: A bird is singing in the tree.

jyutping: jau5 zek3 zoek3 zai2 hai2 syu6 soeng6 min6 coeng3 go1。

english.text: If you won ten million dollars in a lottery, what would you do with that money?

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 jeng4 zo2 jat1 cin1 maan6，nei5 wui5 jung6 di1 cin4 lai4 zou6 me1？

english.text: What are you worried about?

jyutping: nei5 daam1 sam1 di1 me1 aa3？
text: 你擔心啲咩呀？

english.text: That link is staying blue.

jyutping: tiu4 link ngo5 zau6 sei2 dou1 m4 gam6 gaa3 laa3。

english.text: She cannot have done it.

jyutping: mou5 ho2 nang4 hai6 keoi5 zou6 ge3。

english.text: Jim detonated his explosive belt.

jyutping: aa3 Jim jan5 baau3 zo2 keoi5 tiu4 zaa3 daan2 pei4 daai2。

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sam1 cing4 hou2 caa1，jan1 wai6 ngo5 m4 gau3 cin4 sai2。

jyutping: cam4 maan5 jau5 mou4 jing2 soeng2 aa2？

english.text: It's like that sometimes.

text: 我亦一直認為，手槍練習應該係一種露天消遣；而當福爾摩斯喺佢其中一個奇怪嘅幽默入面，會坐喺扶手椅上面，拎住佢嘅髮槍同一百支拳手彈筒，然後繼續前進 用一個用子彈袋做嘅愛國 V. R. 裝飾對面嘅牆，我好強烈噉覺得我哋間房嘅氣氛同外觀都冇因為佢而得到改善。

english.text: After the capture of Syracuse by the Romans, silver, the foundation of the treasure they had seized, fell suddenly in price, so that seventeen pounds of silver were valued at one of gold. A little later the relative price was as 12 to 1, when Caesar, having plundered the two milliards contained in the public chest, so reduced the value of gold, which then predominated, that the proportion fell to 9 to 1.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It may seem wonderful that language, which is the only method of conveying our conceptions, should, at the same time, be an hindrance to our advancement in philosophy; but the wonder ceases when we consider, that it is seldom studied as the vehicle of truth, but is too frequently esteemed for its own sake, independent of its connection with things.

jyutping: jyu5 jin4，hai6 wai4 jat1 cyun4 daat6 ngo5 dei6 koi3 nim6 ge3 fong1 faat3，tung4 si4 jing1 goi1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 hai2 zit3 hok6 soeng6 ge3 zeon3 bou6 ge3 zo2 ngoi6，ni1 go3 ho2 nang4 ci5 fu4 hou3 kei4 miu6；daan6 hai6 dong1 ngo5 dei6 haau2 leoi6 dou3，keoi5 hou2 siu2 bei6 jan4 jin4 gau3 wai6 zan1 lei5 ge3 zoi3 tai2，ji4 hai6 taai3 soeng4 wai6 zo2 keoi5 bun2 san1 ji4 bei6 zyun1 zung6，duk6 laap6 jyu1 keoi5 tung4 si6 mat6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6，ni1 go3 kei4 zik1 zau6 ting4 zi2 zo2。
text: 語言，係唯一傳達我哋概念嘅方法，同時應該係我哋喺哲學上嘅進步嘅阻礙，呢個可能似乎好奇妙；但係當我哋考慮到，佢好少被人研究為真理嘅載體，而係太常為咗佢本身而被尊重，獨立於佢同事物嘅關係，呢個奇蹟就停止咗。
